Adds `specs/minds-eval-harbor/harness_arms.md`: how one minds_evals run drives every case on a chosen harness (the provider lane the workspace is signed in on) and model (set through the workspace's own model endpoint before the first turn), what each trial records about the harness config it was asked to run versus the one it observed, how grading behaves on a non-claude harness, and how the same flags become a matrix of arms -- a pair times a harness config -- in the scheduled CI.
